facts.item: vision loss in the right eye
facts.text: I've been losing the vision in my right eye.

facts.item: vision loss in the right eye: course

facts.text: I have trouble seeing in the dark.
I first noticed it in my 50s.
Driving through tunnels was particularly difficult.
Glare hasn't been a problem for me.
Bright light doesn't bother my eyes.
At 69 I had cataract surgery on both eyes.
My vision improved only for a short while afterwards.
At 54 I had a squamous cell carcinoma, a skin cancer, cut out of a fingertip.
Apart from the cataracts and that skin cancer, I've had no other medical problems.
No one in my family has had eye disease.
My parents were not related to each other by blood.

findings.name: best-corrected visual acuity
findings.result: 0.08 in the right eye; 0.8 in the left eye.

findings.name: slit-lamp examination of the anterior segment
findings.result: Anterior segments and intraocular lenses unremarkable.

findings.name: intraocular pressure
findings.result: 14 mm Hg right; 13 mm Hg left.

findings.name: fundoscopy
findings.result: Well-demarcated, symmetrical macular atrophy with a greater vertical than horizontal diameter, extending to and beyond the vascular arcades; yellowish-white, net-like pseudodrusen widespread throughout both retinas.

findings.name: fundus autofluorescence
findings.result: Well-demarcated, symmetrical macular atrophy with a greater vertical than horizontal diameter, extending to and beyond the vascular arcades.

findings.name: ultra-wide-field imaging
findings.result: Extensive pseudodrusen beyond the arcades; no mid-peripheral hypoautofluorescence or peripheral paving-stone degeneration.

findings.name: swept-source OCT
findings.result: Extensive outer nuclear layer atrophy; loss of the ellipsoid and cone outer segment termination lines, replaced by subretinal hyperreflective material; marked choroidal thinning.

findings.name: fluorescein angiography
findings.result: Window defects without leakage or staining.

findings.name: indocyanine green angiography
findings.result: Choroidal vessels delineated in the atrophic areas, without evidence of neovascularization.

findings.name: wide-field OCT angiography
findings.result: Preserved superficial and deep capillary plexuses and foveal avascular zone; attenuation of the choriocapillaris and deeper choroidal vessels in the atrophic regions.

findings.name: perimetry
findings.result: Kinetic and static perimetry: paracentral scotomas with unreliable fixation.

findings.name: electroretinography
findings.result: Electronegative bright-flash waveform; normal rod response, cone response, and 30 Hz flicker; preserved on and off responses on long-flash testing.

findings.name: equatorial OCT
findings.result: Pseudodrusen beneath the retinal pigment epithelium protruding into the outer nuclear layer, consistent with reticular pseudodrusen.

aliases: extensive macular atrophy with pseudodrusen-like appearance
gold.reasoning: 1. Consideration of diffuse trickling geographic atrophy (a severe form of dry AMD) — “In contrast to EMAP, patients with diffuse trickling geographic atrophy frequently have severe vascular or cardiac disorders; however, our patient had no preexisting medical conditions.” 2. Consideration of retinitis pigmentosa — “No obvious degeneration or low autofluorescence was observed in the mid-periphery, which is the area most likely to be affected first in retinitis pigmentosa.” 3. Consideration of choroidal neovascularization — “IA showed clearly delineated choroidal vessels in the degenerated area but no sign of CNV,” and “no suspicious signals for CNV were detected in the avascular slab.”

x004: s009 does not name the modality that showed the pseudodrusen; it follows the fundoscopy sentence and is placed with fundoscopy.
x013: Reticular pseudodrusen lie above the retinal pigment epithelium; 'beneath the retinal pigment epithelium protruding into the outer nuclear layer' is kept as written (see source_issues).

leakage.reason: Fundoscopy result describes macular atrophy and pseudodrusen; the gold label is a description of exactly this appearance (selection.leakage = test_result), so the examination cannot be reported without it.
Autofluorescence result describes macular atrophy, words of the descriptive gold label.
Ultra-wide-field result reports extensive pseudodrusen, words of the descriptive gold label.
OCT report says 'extensive outer nuclear layer atrophy'; descriptive words shared with the gold label.
Equatorial OCT report names pseudodrusen (reticular pseudodrusen), part of the gold label.

source_issues: s017 places reticular pseudodrusen 'beneath the retinal pigment epithelium' yet 'protruding into the outer nuclear layer'; reticular pseudodrusen are subretinal (above the RPE), so 'beneath' is probably an error.
s008 reports fundoscopy and fundus autofluorescence together, so both records carry the same description.
notes: Index visit: the referral evaluation for progressive vision loss in the right eye (s001), with the full ophthalmic examination and imaging of that evaluation (s006–s017).

The gold label is descriptive (extensive macular atrophy with pseudodrusen), so the imaging results necessarily contain its words; they are written reports or descriptive examination findings and are listed in qc.leakage.
